name: 20864-mtpdecode-qwen35moe35b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, bf16. 71.9 GB of weights, Apache-2.0, ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 512 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no shared prefix: 1024 prompt tokens (stdev 0) against 1024 output tokens (stdev 0), with ignore_eos: true and temperature 0.0.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 35-billion-parameter model, serving 32 concurrent users across four GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED and the engine starts without it. A bool is
# a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`. Environment variables cannot live here; configs/tuned.yaml has the
# one this setup needs.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

tp-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16

speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Not the default (`auto` resolves to `no_buffer`), and it requires the radix cache left enabled --
# the server refuses to start with `--disable-radix-cache`, which is why no cache flag appears.
mamba-scheduler-strategy: extra_buffer

# Not optional: any speculative algorithm resets max_running_requests to 48 when it is unset.
max-running-requests: 64

context-length: 4096
attention-backend: fa3
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 20864
